title: ChartRevise: A Dataset and Evaluation Protocol for Exact Chart Editing via Code
abstract: arXiv:2609.38642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chart editing requires cross-modal edit grounding, realizing a requested visual change in the code that draws it, with necessary related updates and without altering unrelated content. Existing benchmarks emphasize either code executability or chart quality, but their metrics do not clearly distinguish request completion from missed coupled updates and gratuitous changes. We introduce ChartRevise, a structured dataset and evaluation protocol for exact program-grounded chart editing. For dataset construction, we build on the grammar of graphics to systematically cover chart-editing operations, using source-program checks to verify their applicability across chart types and libraries. To improve edit exactness, our pipeline checks individual requirements and guides repair or exclusion when they are unmet. The resulting dataset contains 92,438 records covering 344 edit types across 20 chart types and three plotting libraries. For evaluation

translated_abstract: 图表编辑需要跨模态的编辑定位，即在绘制图表的代码中实现所请求的视觉变更，同时进行必要的关联更新，且不改动无关内容。现有基准要么强调代码可执行性，要么强调图表质量，但其指标无法清晰区分请求是否完成、遗漏的关联更新以及不必要的变更。我们提出了ChartRevise，一个用于精确的基于程序的图表编辑的结构化数据集与评估协议。在数据集构建方面，我们基于图形语法系统地覆盖各类图表编辑操作，并使用源程序检查来验证这些操作在不同图表类型和绘图库中的适用性。为提高编辑的精确性，我们的流程会逐一检查各项要求，并在要求未满足时指导修复或排除。最终得到的数据集包含92,438条记录，涵盖20种图表类型和三个绘图库中的344种编辑类型。对于评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了ChartRevise数据集与评估协议，基于图形语法系统构建了包含92,438条记录、覆盖20种图表类型和344种编辑类型的精确图表代码编辑基准，其指标能够明确区分请求完成、遗漏关联更新与不必要的变更。
en_tdlr: ChartRevise introduces a structured dataset and evaluation protocol for exact program-grounded chart editing, with 92,438 records covering 344 edit types across 20 chart types and three plotting libraries, whose metrics clearly distinguish request completion from missed coupled updates and gratuitous changes.
